CustomField.description: Indicates if the Pay Transaction Contributes to Qualifying Earnings as per the related Pay Code
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( tc9_pr__Pay_Code__r.RecordType.DeveloperName != 'Deduction', tc9_pr__Pay_Code__r.tc9_pr__Contributes_to_Qualifying_Earnings__c = true ), true, IF( AND( tc9_pr__Pay_Code__r.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Deduction', tc9_pr__Pay_Code__r.tc9_pr__Deduction_Reduces_Qualifying_Earnings__c = true ), true, false ) )
